en_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Is Already Running Rampant on PC — but Can Nintendo Do Anything About It?
cn_title: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版已在PC上泛滥，但任天堂能对此采取什么行动吗？
opus_summary: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版推出后，玩家迅速通过模拟器和重编译工具在PC上运行游戏。法律专家认为，模拟器本身通常合法，但规避技术保护措施可能引发法律问题；他们对用户及相关工具面临的风险看法不一。

paragraphs.en: Shortly after the release of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake , players quickly found ways to start playing it on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版发售后不久，玩家们很快就找到了在PC上游玩的方法。

paragraphs.en: This was done through a few different methods. One is through an emulator, whereas others are through recompilation tools, which run the game natively on PC without emulating the Switch 2. Either way, the people who make these emulators and tools insist that users have to supply their own game files, so the downloads won’t work on their own. In other words, they want you to buy the game before you start playing it on PC, to cover their backs.
paragraphs.cn: 实现这一点有几种不同的方法。一种是通过模拟器，另一些则是通过重编译工具，后者无需模拟Switch 2就能在PC上原生运行游戏。无论哪种方式，这些模拟器和工具的制作者都坚持要求用户自行提供游戏文件，因此下载的内容本身无法独立运行。换句话说，为了保护自己，他们希望你先购买游戏，再开始在PC上游玩。

paragraphs.en: This is nothing new for a big release, but we’ve never seen it done so quickly before. That’s because many of these emulators and tools were AI-assisted, which is also why you have seen so many other “native” PC ports of games floating around (to mixed results — and fears concerning how safe they actually are to play).
paragraphs.cn: 对于一款重磅游戏来说，这并不是什么新鲜事，但我们以前从未见过它如此迅速地实现。这是因为许多此类模拟器和工具都借助了AI，这也是为什么你能看到如此多其他游戏的「原生」PC移植版流传（效果好坏不一，而且人们也担心游玩它们究竟有多安全）。

paragraphs.en: But it’s these PC ports of Ocarina of Time that have gotten the most attention. Some players have even managed to get an unofficial multiplayer release going, mere days after the game launched on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 但受到最多关注的是这些《时之笛》PC移植版。游戏在PC上推出仅仅几天后，一些玩家甚至已经成功弄出了一个非官方多人游戏版本。

paragraphs.en: There's a lot to say about these, but debates over quality or AI usage aside, the most obvious question is: will Nintendo put up with this? The company is notoriously litigious and has successfully sued emulators before. It even started taking down Nintendo Switch 2 emulators earlier this month, so many would assume that it is only a matter of time until it does something about the Ocarina of Time craze.
paragraphs.cn: 关于这些版本有很多可说的，但抛开对质量或AI使用的争论，最显而易见的问题是：任天堂会容忍这种情况吗？这家公司出了名地爱打官司，此前曾成功起诉过模拟器。它甚至在本月早些时候开始下架Switch 2模拟器，因此许多人会认为，它对这股《时之笛》热潮采取行动只是时间问题。

paragraphs.en: However, according to legal experts speaking with IGN, it won’t be a clear-cut case for Nintendo.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，据接受IGN采访的法律专家所说，这对任天堂而言不会是一场结果明朗的官司。

paragraphs.en: “The basic arrangement of the emulator as just being a piece of software capable of running games that you have to provide separately is critical,” Kirk Sigmon, founding partner at KellDann Law, told IGN. “At least in theory, the law is very favorable towards emulators.”
paragraphs.cn: KellDann Law创始合伙人Kirk Sigmon告诉IGN：「模拟器的基本设计是，它只是一款能够运行游戏的软件，而游戏必须由用户另行提供，这一点至关重要。至少在理论上，法律对模拟器非常有利。」

paragraphs.en: He went on to cite a case from 2000 in which Sony unsuccessfully sued the creator of an original PlayStation emulator. “[This case] basically indicates that emulators are (on their own) legal and the reverse engineering of game consoles can also be legal, even when performed in a manner that might otherwise arguably infringe copyright law,” he argued.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着引用了2000年的一起案件：索尼起诉一款初代PlayStation模拟器的制作者，但未能胜诉。他认为：「［这起案件］基本表明，模拟器（本身）是合法的，对游戏主机进行逆向工程也可能是合法的，即便所采用的方式在其他情况下可以说可能违反版权法。」

paragraphs.en: This could apply to all the tools being used to play the Ocarina of Time remake on PC, including the popular new emulator, Lichii. “If it was developed using AI and without stealing trade secrets, and if it’s carefully managed to never include Nintendo’s other IP, it’ll be hard to stop,” Sigmon said.
paragraphs.cn: 这可能适用于所有被用来在PC上游玩《时之笛》重制版的工具，包括新近流行的模拟器Lichii。Sigmon说：「如果它是使用AI开发的，没有窃取商业秘密，而且经过谨慎管理，始终不包含任天堂的其他知识产权内容，那么就很难阻止它。」

paragraphs.en: Others, such as Zohaib Hashim, CEO of Blackmont Legal, echoed this sentiments. “I do not believe that [emulator/decompilation creators] can be said to be breaching copyright or infringing on Nintendo's IP simply by virtue of developing and supplying emulator software,” Hashim said in an interview.
paragraphs.cn: 其他人，例如Blackmont Legal首席执行官Zohaib Hashim，也表达了类似看法。Hashim在一次采访中说：「我不认为仅仅因为［模拟器／反编译工具制作者］开发和提供模拟器软件，就可以说他们违反了版权法或侵犯了任天堂的知识产权。」

paragraphs.en: “Emulators generally are legal; there's established case law going back many years supporting this,” he continued, citing the same Sony lawsuit.
paragraphs.cn: 他接着引用了同一起索尼诉讼，说：「模拟器通常是合法的；多年前就已有确立的判例支持这一点。」

paragraphs.en: With that said, Sigmon admitted that Nintendo won’t take this lying down. “Nintendo is absolutely going to try to shut Lichii and/or the decompilation teams down,” he predicted. “Nintendo is likely looking for any possible justification for going after them: the accidental use of some art/music asset, the inadvertent use of a logo, evidence that they stole some sort of trade secret, or the like.
paragraphs.cn: 话虽如此，Sigmon承认任天堂不会对此坐视不管。他预测：「任天堂绝对会试图关闭Lichii和／或解散反编译团队。任天堂很可能正在寻找任何可能的理由来追究他们：意外使用了某些美术／音乐素材、无意中使用了某个标志、他们窃取了某种商业秘密的证据，或诸如此类的东西。

paragraphs.en: “There’s even a possibility that they’ll try to shut them down for orthogonally related activities, like uploading videos of emulated game content on YouTube. After all, some gamers are already enjoying the Ocarina of Time remake on their computers mere days after the game was released. That can’t be good for the game’s sales targets.” Just days after we spoke, Nintendo started to get videos showing the Ocarina of Time remake PC port removed from YouTube over copyright claims.
paragraphs.cn: 「他们甚至有可能因为一些间接相关的活动而试图让他们停止运作，比如在YouTube上传模拟游戏内容的视频。毕竟，游戏发售仅仅几天后，一些玩家已经在电脑上享受《时之笛》重制版了。这对游戏的销售目标肯定没有好处。」就在我们交谈几天后，任天堂开始通过版权投诉，让YouTube移除展示《时之笛》重制版PC移植版的视频。

paragraphs.en: Other experts I spoke to highlighted possible flaws in the creators’ defence. Michael Dilworth, managing partner of Dilworth IP LLC, said that insisting users supply their own game “only gets them so far.”
paragraphs.cn: 我采访的其他专家指出了制作者辩护中可能存在的漏洞。Dilworth IP LLC管理合伙人Michael Dilworth表示，坚持要求用户自行提供游戏「只能在一定程度上保护他们」。

paragraphs.en: “Emulation itself is not inherently unlawful under U.S. copyright law,” Dilworth said. “The more difficult issue involves the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA), which restricts the circumvention of technological protections and the distribution of certain circumvention technologies.”
paragraphs.cn: Dilworth说：「根据美国版权法，模拟本身并非天然违法。更棘手的问题涉及《数字千年版权法》（DMCA），该法限制绕过技术保护措施以及传播某些用于绕过保护的技术。」

paragraphs.en: In other words, Nintendo could dive into how these tools work, rather than solely complain about the fact that the emulator exists at all. “Nintendo relied heavily on that statute in its case against Yuzu, and its recent enforcement activity suggests that circumvention remains central to its legal strategy,” Dilworth said.
paragraphs.cn: 换句话说，任天堂可以深入调查这些工具的工作原理，而不只是针对模拟器的存在提出异议。Dilworth说：「任天堂在起诉Yuzu的案件中严重依赖那项法律，而它最近的维权行动表明，绕过保护措施仍是其法律策略的核心。」

paragraphs.en: On the whole, it seems to be agreed that those operating emulators or recompilation tools have a decent defence, so what about the people using them?
paragraphs.cn: 总体而言，人们似乎一致认为，运营模拟器或重编译工具的人有相当充分的辩护理由，那么使用这些工具的人呢？

paragraphs.en: That’s where we see a difference in opinion. I raised the point with Sigmon that Switch 2 users have to sign an end-user licence agreement (EULA), which could be breached by decompiling legitimately purchased projects. He did not feel that Nintendo had a leg to stand on here.
paragraphs.cn: 在这个问题上，意见出现了分歧。我向Sigmon提出，Switch 2用户必须签署最终用户许可协议（EULA），而对合法购买的项目进行反编译可能会违反该协议。他认为任天堂在这一点上站不住脚。

paragraphs.en: “That’s just words on a page that Nintendo would have to try to actually enforce in a court or some sort of arbitration tribunal,” Sigmon said. “Such enforcement would introduce a lot of hurdles — for example, it’s possible that someone might buy a Nintendo Switch 2 and use it for reverse engineering purposes without ever agreeing to Nintendo’s EULA.”
paragraphs.cn: Sigmon说：「那只是纸面上的文字，任天堂必须设法在法庭或某种仲裁庭上实际执行它。这样的执行会面临许多障碍——例如，有人可能购买一台Switch 2并将其用于逆向工程，却从未同意过任天堂的最终用户许可协议。」

paragraphs.en: However, Hashim came at this issue from another angle. “Circumvention of DRM protections are considered an infringement, and there isn't a permitted purpose for decompiling the code for this specific purpose,” he argued. “The decompiling of the code may additionally be a violation of Nintendo's EULA and TOS, which entitles them to cancel the licence granted to the infringing party.” He also stressed that this applies regardless of whether you bought the game physically or digitally; either way, you bought a licence for the game.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，Hashim从另一个角度看待这个问题。他认为：「绕过DRM保护被视为侵权，而为了这一特定目的反编译代码并不属于获准的用途。反编译代码还可能违反任天堂的最终用户许可协议和服务条款，这使任天堂有权取消授予侵权方的许可。」他还强调，无论你购买的是实体版还是数字版游戏，这都适用；无论哪种情况，你买到的都是游戏的使用许可。

paragraphs.en: Marcus Denning, principal and senior lawyer at MK Law, also made this case. “Owning a legitimate copy of a Nintendo game does not necessarily give a user permission to bypass the console's technical protections,” he said, adding that this applies whether or not you go on to share the files with others. “Copyright law addresses activities such as reproducing and distributing protected works. Separate provisions may also apply when technological measures used to control access to copyrighted material are bypassed.
paragraphs.cn: MK Law负责人兼资深律师Marcus Denning也提出了这一观点。他说：「拥有一份正版任天堂游戏，并不一定意味着用户获准绕过主机的技术保护措施。」他补充说，无论之后是否将文件分享给他人，这一点都适用。「版权法涉及复制和传播受保护作品等行为。当用于控制受版权保护材料访问权限的技术措施被绕过时，也可能适用其他条款。

paragraphs.en: “Ultimately, purchasing a legitimate copy of a game is only one part of the legal question. How the emulator operates and how users access the game files also matter under the applicable copyright laws.”
paragraphs.cn: 「归根结底，购买一份正版游戏只是法律问题的一部分。根据适用的版权法，模拟器如何运行以及用户如何获取游戏文件也很重要。」

paragraphs.en: What is more complicated is the legality behind sharing advice on how to play Ocarina of Time remake on PC.Sigmon said that, according to the law, content creators could in theory be free to upload videos showing exactly how they got their legally purchased copies of the game playable on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 更复杂的是，分享如何在PC上游玩《时之笛》重制版的建议是否合法。Sigmon表示，根据法律，内容创作者理论上可以自由上传视频，详细展示他们如何让自己合法购买的游戏在PC上运行。

paragraphs.en: However, Dilworth expressed some concern: “Explaining how software works or examining its underlying functionality isn't necessarily unlawful. But distributing tools or instructions specifically designed to defeat technological protections can raise additional legal concerns under the DMCA.”
paragraphs.cn: 然而，Dilworth表达了一些担忧：「解释软件如何工作或研究其底层功能并不一定违法。但传播专门用于突破技术保护措施的工具或说明，可能会根据《数字千年版权法》引发额外的法律问题。」

paragraphs.en: With all of this said, we all know that Nintendo has successfully taken some emulators down. For instance, Yuzu was shut down after being sued by Nintendo, resulting in a $2.4 million payout in Nintendo’s favor .
paragraphs.cn: 尽管如此，我们都知道任天堂曾成功让一些模拟器停止运营。例如，Yuzu在遭到任天堂起诉后被关闭，任天堂还因此获得了240万美元的赔偿。

paragraphs.en: If Nintendo wants to take on emulators and decompilers using the same method, I’m told that it would have to prove that they are actively bypassing protections put in place by Nintendo.
paragraphs.cn: 有人告诉我，如果任天堂想用同样的方法对付模拟器和反编译工具，就必须证明它们正在主动绕过任天堂设置的保护措施。

paragraphs.en: “The case was Nintendo of America v. Tropic Haze LLC, and it essentially focused on Yuzu’s action of decrypting game files immediately before and during runtime using copies of Nintendo Switch-derived cryptographic keys,” Sigmon explained. He said it is “unclear” if Nintendo could use the same argument with the tools being used to play Ocarina of Time on PC.
paragraphs.cn: Sigmon解释说：「那起案件是任天堂of America诉Tropic Haze LLC案，其核心基本上是Yuzu使用从任天堂Switch获取的加密密钥副本，在运行前和运行期间解密游戏文件的行为。」他说，任天堂能否用同样的论点对付那些被用来在PC上游玩《时之笛》的工具，目前「尚不清楚」。

paragraphs.en: “LLM [AI] tools have made it far, far easier to develop emulators without necessarily needing to circumvent anything and/or pilfer any trade secrets, and my understanding is that the current ROMs floating around of Switch 2 games are already decrypted,” he continued. “If that’s true, and if Lichii is just playing those already-decrypted ROMs without circumvention, they might be in a better position than those in Tropic Haze [creator of Yuzu].”
paragraphs.cn: 他继续说：「LLM［AI］工具使开发模拟器变得容易得多，而且不一定需要绕过任何东西和／或窃取任何商业秘密。据我了解，目前流传的Switch 2游戏ROM已经解密了。如果这是真的，而且Lichii只是在运行那些已经解密的ROM，没有绕过保护措施，那么他们的处境可能会比Tropic Haze［Yuzu的制作者］的人更有利。」

paragraphs.en: Dilworth, meanwhile, noted that some of these projects, including Lichii, are built on Yuzu’s work, which could be brought up in court. “That connection matters because Nintendo successfully pursued Yuzu's developer in 2024,” Dilworth said. “But the case was resolved without a trial, so it didn't establish that video game emulators are generally unlawful.
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，Dilworth指出，包括Lichii在内的一些项目建立在Yuzu的成果之上，这一点可能会在法庭上被提及。Dilworth说：「这种联系很重要，因为任天堂在2024年成功追究了Yuzu开发者的责任。但该案未经审判就得到了解决，因此它并未确立电子游戏模拟器普遍违法这一点。

paragraphs.en: “Simply using code derived from Yuzu doesn't automatically make Lichii unlawful. But if Lichii retains functionality that Nintendo previously challenged, I would expect Nintendo to raise similar legal arguments.”
paragraphs.cn: 「仅仅使用源自Yuzu的代码，不会自动使Lichii违法。但如果Lichii保留了任天堂此前提出异议的功能，我预计任天堂会提出类似的法律论点。」

paragraphs.en: He also believes that Nintendo is likely to take action, saying that Lichii has “good reason to be concerned.”
paragraphs.cn: 他还认为任天堂很可能采取行动，称Lichii「有充分的理由感到担忧」。

paragraphs.en: Whatever defences the creators of these tools have, one thing is clear: Nintendo won’t like them. And because it doesn’t like them, it will likely try to take them on. However, it might have greater success in pursuing DMCA claims , as it did with Yuzu.
paragraphs.cn: 无论这些工具的制作者有什么辩护理由，有一点是明确的：任天堂不会喜欢它们。而由于任天堂不喜欢它们，它很可能会试图对付它们。不过，像对付Yuzu时那样依据《数字千年版权法》提出诉求，可能会让它更有可能成功。

paragraphs.en: A lot will depend on how the tools used to run Ocarina of Time were made. If they were found to have used tech from Yuzu that was part of Nintendo’s settlement with the creator, they could face trouble. In any case, these tools are running rampant now, and it’s hard to see how legal action can put the genie back in the bottle. If any company were going to tackle this, it would be Nintendo, but that doesn’t mean it’s in for an easy ride.
paragraphs.cn: 许多事情将取决于用于运行《时之笛》的工具是如何制作的。如果被发现使用了Yuzu的技术，而这些技术属于任天堂与制作者达成的和解协议的一部分，它们就可能面临麻烦。无论如何，这些工具如今正在泛滥，很难想象法律行动如何才能让一切恢复原状。如果有哪家公司会着手解决这个问题，那一定是任天堂，但这并不意味着它会一帆风顺。
